title: kOA Node Profile Artifact
description: Defines one signed, integrity-protected, machine-readable node-profile artifact. The artifact declares the exact primary deployment profile, overlays, node identity, operating modes, capabilities, component membership, hardware envelope, storage, network, offline behavior, security, governance, release state, lifecycle, recovery, conformance, provenance, integrity, signing, traceability, and activation validation for one kOA node or node template. Profile membership and semantics remain owned by the canonical profile index and profile contracts.

$schema.description: Repository-relative schema reference used by node-profile artifacts stored under contracts/examples or an equivalent resolved location.
